prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one high-fidelity design proposal board for the GINA backoffice "Taslak paketler" editorial workflow. Reference image 1 is the already approved visual language, NOT the content of this screen. Reference image 2 is the existing original GINA logo, preserve its mint mascot and purple lowercase letterforms; use very small logos, no new mascots. Match warm ivory surfaces, readable deep aubergine text, quiet lavender edges, mint status notes, rounded characterful headings and clean rounded sans-serif body. Professional premium educational publishing workspace. Restrained soft elevation and satin purple buttons. No new brand or dark/gold luxury direction.

Composition: wide 2400x1600 design presentation. Large desktop viewport on left (roughly 1440x1000 proportions), separate smaller portrait tablet viewport on right, NOT overlapping the desktop content. Thin frames, no photoreal hardware. Both views legible, with generous minimum touch controls and no clipped footers. Bottom presentation label "TASARIM ÖNERİSİ · ÖRNEK TASLAK". This is NOT a production screenshot.

Desktop:
Slim cream navigation rail with small original logo, "Yönetim alanı", one selected "Kütüphane" item. Main heading "GINA kütüphanesi". Compact navigation tabs "Koleksiyonlar", selected "Taslak paketler", "Katkılar", "Haklar". Modest outlined top-right "Paket yükle" with upload icon.
Small breadcrumb stepper "1 Dosya" → selected "2 Önizleme" → "3 İnceleme".
Package heading "Geometrik şekiller", metadata "5. sınıf · Matematik · Sürüm 1", quiet counts "20 soru · 8 ortak kaynak".
Mint status line with lock icon: "Taslak · Ailelere görünmez".
Review workspace has narrow question list at left and spacious question panel at right. List title "Sorular", three representative rows "01  Doğru parçası ve ışın" selected, "02  Bir ışın çizelim", "03  Dik kesişen doğrular". Small honest caption "20 sorunun ilk 3’ü". No fake completion or approval ticks.
Main panel heading "Soru 1 / 20", segmented switch "Öğrenci görünümü" selected and "Cevap ve puanlama". Small quiet label "Ortak kaynak" and expand icon with label "Büyüt".
A clean wide cream diagram: at top a horizontal dark purple segment A—B with filled dots at BOTH endpoints; below it horizontal ray C—D→ with filled initial dot at C, a point D partway along and an arrow to the RIGHT beyond D. Make mathematically correct simple geometry, never arrows at A/B and no left arrow at C. Comfortable readable labels.
Question text below: "AB ve CD çizimlerinin geometrik adlarını yaz. Uç noktaları ve devam yönleri bakımından aralarındaki farkı açıkla."
A pale lavender note with information icon: "Müfredat eşlemesi inceleme bekliyor."
Bottom action bar: subtle text link "Sonraki soru →" and ONE main purple button "İncelemeye geç". No Publish button, no AI generation, no duplicate primary actions.

Tablet:
Collapsed header with menu icon, original small logo and "Yönetim".
Back link "← Taslak paketler", heading "Geometrik şekiller", metadata "5. sınıf · Matematik".
Stepper with "3 İnceleme" active.
Label "Soru 1 / 20" and a small outlined "Soruyu aç" link.
Cream answer card heading "Cevap ve puanlama", short answer "AB bir doğru parçası, CD bir ışındır." Two compact lines explaining endpoint versus direction without redundant large cards.
Heading "Puan ölçütleri · 4 puan" with four neat aligned rows, each 1 puan:
"AB’yi doğru parçası olarak tanımlar."
"CD’yi ışın olarak tanımlar."
"AB’nin iki uçla sınırlı olduğunu açıklar."
"CD’nin devam yönünü açıklar."
An understated compact labeled review selector "İnceleme sonucu" with "Düzeltme gerekli" selected, then a comfortable textarea labeled "İnceleme notu" with example "İfade ve görsel okunabilirliği kontrol edilecek."
At bottom ONE main purple "İncelemeyi kaydet" button; clear small line "Bu işlem paketi yayımlamaz."
Do not imply all 20 questions reviewed. No school approval badge. Tablet review notes are operator-only, not child feedback.
Exact Turkish diacritics, calm layout, high contrast text, no stacked button clutter, no giant decorative mascot, no fabricated charts, no gold, no excessive gradients.
scope: Existing library navigation plus draft packages; no parallel library area
Select a package file, explicitly save a private draft, preview a pinned immutable version
Student view separated from answer/rubric view
Per-question editorial review recorded against package and question revisions
Responsive desktop and tablet; narrow view sequential
implementationNotes: Image is a design proposal, not a running application. No upload or editorial review was executed.
Native text and semantic controls must be implemented; never use the full image as the UI.
Keep all existing collections, contributions, rights and rewards; 'Katkılar' clarifies the currently named contribution review tab.
The selected file is local until explicit draft save. Show parsing, format/hash/size errors and an explicit cancel/replace action. Do not automatically upload on file selection.
The load flow reuses p_request_id on retries; persist uncertain sends in a private user-scoped outbox. Do not silently retry as a new command.
Student preview is an admin-only projection, not proof of exact child app rendering; no answers/private metadata in its DOM or accessibility tree.
Primary action before saving is 'Taslak olarak kaydet'. In the mockup it is already saved, so primary action is 'İncelemeye geç'.
Question list must show all 20 items through a scrollable or paginated list, not only the illustrative three. Default review filter 'Tümü'; retain selected question when its status changes.
Tablet shows question-level review of question 1, not completion of all 20. Review outcomes: not reviewed, changes requested, suitable. Note required for changes requested.
Review is a separate server record with actor/time, package id, question key/revision, status and rationale; immutable package content is never overwritten.
Review mutating RPC and revision-bound concurrency/idempotency are not yet implemented. Live authorization must match the import admin permission; no content/support role access assumed.
A new package/source/question revision does not silently inherit editorial approval. Source change must mark every dependent question for review.
No publication, family entitlement, package quota, rewards or Prova assignment occurs on review save. Future publish must verify whole exact package version and prerequisites.
The image shows a small diagram; actual preview must honor minimum_reading_width and allow accessible zoom, including on tablet portrait.
Support keyboard focus order, labels, reduced motion, readable errors, 48px controls; confirmation before losing unsaved notes.

Empty/no selection, loading, malformed file, image decode failure, denied/revoked access, stale review and uncertain send need explicit states; they are behavior specs, not screenshot-verified states.
No application code, database, hosting or TestFlight changes in this proposal.
